run_nvemd_reducer_join_results: run NVEMDReducer join_results to collect total energy drift values from NVE MD simulation output files
compute_nvemd_drift_metrics: compute the mean total energy drift in meV/atom/ps across all NVE MD simulation results
calculate_te_drift: calculate the total energy drift from an NVE MD trajectory file after removing equilibration steps
save_nvemd_results: save NVE MD benchmark results as a text file with one drift value per line
log_nvemd_metrics: log NVE MD benchmark metrics DataFrame to the configured logger for tracking drift performance
